content.what_it_is: Preprocessed (build/pre) FUNWAVE-TVD MODULE PARALLEL_FIELD_IO (L65-L233, USE GLOBAL @L66): field-output subroutines for parallel runs, described @L57-L58 as 'subroutines for outputting field data in various data format' (HISTORY 12/06/2017 Michael-Angelo Y.-H. Lam @L61; BSD header L12-L55). PutFileASCII(FILE,PHI) (L70-L167, ykchoi 06/May/2017 rewrite markers @L76/L90/L104/L165): on first call builds the runtime format string FORMAT_LEN as '(', Mglob(I7), 'E16.6', ')' via internal writes (L98-L101, guarded by SAVEd FirstCallPutFile L91-L96); strips ghost cells into LocalPHI=PHI(Ibeg:Iend,Jbeg:Jend) @L110; MPI_Gathers each rank's iista/iiend/jjsta/jjend to rank 0 (L114-L121); rank 0 places its own block into PHIGLOB(iista:iiend,jjsta:jjend) @L124 then for irank=1..px*py-1 computes lenx/leny/lenxy (L130-L132), allocates buffer xx, receives via mpi_irecv+mpi_wait (L135-L136) and copies into PHIGLOB @L138, while the sending rank posts mpi_isend+mpi_wait of LocalPHI (L143-L145); finally rank 0 writes PHIGLOB to unit 1 in ASCII with stride OUTPUT_RES over J=1,NGlob and implied-do I=1,MGlob (L154-L163). PutFileBinary(FILE_NAME,PHI) (L171-L231; comment L169-L170: 'Code derived from William D. Gropp lecture slides 33', URL lecture33.pdf): MPI-IO collective write — builds local subarray type (sizes_loc=Mloc/Nloc L188-L189, subsizes minus 2*Nghost L191-L192, start_index Nghost L194-L195) and global subarray type (sizes_glob=Mglob/Nglob L199-L200, subsizes_glob=subsizes_loc L202-L203, start_index_glob=iista-1/jjsta-1 L205-L206) via MPI_TYPE_CREATE_SUBARRAY+MPI_TYPE_COMMIT (L209-L216), then MPI_FILE_OPEN (WRONLY+CREATE L219-L221), MPI_FILE_SET_VIEW with 'native' representation @L223, MPI_FILE_WRITE_ALL @L226, MPI_FILE_CLOSE @L228.

verbatim_spans.text: ! Code derived from William D. Gropp lecture slides 33

unresolved: Loop indices J @L155 and I @L156 are not declared anywhere in PutFileASCII despite IMPLICIT NONE @L72 — they must be host-associated through USE GLOBAL @L66; whether GLOBAL provides I,J cannot be confirmed from this file

PHITEST @L176 and istatus @L178 (scalar INTEGER) are declared in PutFileBinary but never used (the write uses MPI_STATUS_IGNORE @L226); istatus in PutFileASCII @L83 is by contrast an array of size mpi_status_size
FORMAT_LEN (from GLOBAL) is built only once under FirstCallPutFile (L95-L102); the Mglob value is frozen into the format at first call — cross-line relation L91/L96/L98-L101 with the WRITE @L156
PHIGLOB is a full Mglob x Nglob automatic array allocated on every rank @L89 even though only rank 0 uses it (L123-L125, L153-L164)
mpi_sp datatype and mpi_status_size come from USE GLOBAL/MPI; their definitions are outside this file
PutFileBinary writes PHI with mem_type_loc which skips ghost cells; strides OUTPUT_RES are not applied in the binary path (contrast ASCII loop L155-L156)
END SUBROUTINE names PutfileASCII @L167 / PutfileBinary @L231 differ in letter case from declarations PutFileASCII @L70 / PutFileBinary @L171 (legal in Fortran, case-insensitive)
